newsitem.title: USA: Budgetel Inns sues MICROS Systems.
newsitem.headline: Budgetel Inns sues MICROS Systems.

text.p: Budgetel Inns Inc said Monday it sued MICROS Systems Inc alleging fraud, violations of the Racketeer Influenced Corrupt Organizations Act (RICO) and the Wisconsin Organized Crime Control Act and breach of contract.
According to the complaint, Budgetel's claims arise from the sale by MICROS of its PMS 8500 hotel property management software.
Budgetel said it alleges that "MICROS deceived (Budgetel) and fraudulently induced (it) to purchase property management software that MICROS would discontinue less than three months later."
Budgetel seeks damages in excess of $1 million, plus punitive and other damages.
Budgetel Inns, a subsidiary of Marcus Corp, operates and franchises 139 inns in 28 states and four Woodfield Suites in Wisconsin, Colorado and Ohio.
MICROS did not immediately comment on the lawsuit Monday.
